entities.summary:
Puerto Iguazú is a border city in the province of Misiones, Argentina. With a population of 82,227 ,
it is the fourth largest city in the Province, after Posadas, Oberá, and Eldorado. The Iguazú Falls are 18 kilometres (11 mi) away from the city, and as a result the city has developed much of its infrastructure around tourism.
